info.title: HQ controller bridge
info.description: The contract between Severino HQ and its infrastructure controller. Each path is one bridge action: a POST over HTTP on HQ's private Unix socket, parameters in the query, the payload as the JSON body, the answer as JSON, and a refusal as an RFC 9457 problem. Go types and the controller's client are generated from this document; HQ's bridge application takes its routes, parameters and limits from it, and Django's tests validate every action against it.

result.description: The provider's last result for this operation, as Django stored it.

Operation.description: A queued or claimed operation, as serialize_operation emits it.

spec.description: Desired state, resolved for the kind. Each provider decodes it into its own type.

observed.description: What the provider was last seen holding for this resource.

Contract.description: The desired-only contract for one resource (export).

verification.description: The operation's action's verification policy, when it declares one.

Pending.description: The next operation (claim/peek). schema_version and resource accompany an operation whose contract resolved; unresolvable explains one that did not (peek only); verification is the action's declared verification policy, when it has one.

Material.description: A stored certificate's material, released only to the controller applying it.

status.description: The provider's status for the resource; its shape belongs to the kind.

expires_at.description: Credential expiry the probe read, when it read one.

store.description: Where the connection's credentials are stored, as connection_env reports it.

ConnectionRecord.description: One connection the controller carries and what its probe found.

StepFailure.description: Work one pass could not finish; subject is the connection ref it used.

RefusedPart.description: One declared part of a reading that was refused: which part, why, and on what ("" scope for all of it).

connected.description: False when nothing this controller holds can read the kind; absent means it was read.

items.description: One record of the kind; Django validates it against that kind's observation schema.

carried.description: True when the kind keeps its own clock and was neither due nor asked for: nothing was asked of the provider, and HQ keeps the last records and when they were read.

Inventory.description: One sweep: each kind read, by kind name.

AnalyticsReadings.description: One controller's reading of every analytics site it can see (record_analytics).

endpoint.description: The National Weather Service API the forecast is read from, as HQ's connection states it.

items.description: One dashboard panel observation (record_dashboard_observations). Not yet produced by the Go controller.

age_seconds.description: Absent before anything has been swept.

Acknowledgement.description: Django's answer to a report; the controller reads only ok.

LockedAction.description: An action the registry refuses, and the reason it gives.

AdmittedExtension.description: One admitted extension's source, from the plugin lock the image carries.

source_repository.description: owner/name of the repository the extension is built from.

source_workflow.description: The workflow whose successful run on main admits it.

ControllerRegistry.description: What the controller may do and where each kind is read, from HQ's provider declarations.

material_kinds.description: Kinds whose work needs material HQ holds.

connection_credentials.description: Providers a connection credential is modelled for.

extensions.description: Each admitted extension the running image composes, which delivery follows.

AnalyticsSiteReading.description: One site's traffic and vitals over whole UTC days, start to end inclusive.

AnalyticsRow.description: One day's count for one value of one breakdown.

AnalyticsVitals.description: One day's site-wide Core Web Vitals.

largest_contentful_paint_ms.description: p75 in milliseconds; null when there were no samples.

interaction_to_next_paint_ms.description: p75 in milliseconds; null when there were no samples.

first_contentful_paint_ms.description: p75 in milliseconds; null when there were no samples.

time_to_first_byte_ms.description: p75 in milliseconds; null when there were no samples.

Verification.description: How long the controller keeps checking that an applied change is actually served, declared by the action it belongs to.

ResourceKind.description: Every kind of resource or reading HQ's provider registry declares. Django's contract test holds this list equal to the registry, so a kind added on either side fails the build.

SweptKind.description: A kind the controller reads in a sweep: exactly the kinds it registers a reader for.

Refusal.description: Why a provider refused a read: the credential itself, or one permission it lacks. Empty when the reason is unclassified.

FailureClass.description: Why a read got no usable answer: a refusal, an address that answered as something other than the API, or nothing answering. Empty when unclassified.

PassMode.description: Whether a pass only looked (plan) or claimed and executed work (apply).

PlannedOperation.description: The operation a plan pass would run next and what it would change.

PlanPassOutput.description: The line a plan pass prints on stdout.

IdlePassOutput.description: The line an apply pass prints when it found nothing to claim.

AppliedOperationOutput.description: The line an apply pass prints for one operation it ran.

RefusedOperationOutput.description: The line an apply pass prints for one operation a provider refused.

TLSConsumerKind.description: Where a certificate is served from: the kinds of TLS consumer a certificate spec declares.

GlancePanelID.description: A dashboard panel the glance plan can ask the controller to read.

CaddyRouteInFile.description: One route in the file HQ writes on a Caddy edge. The file is text, so each value is one token: a hostname (a wildcard allowed) and an upstream as host:port or scheme://host:port. HQ validates a declaration with these patterns and the controller checks them again on the line that writes the file.

CaddyCertificateDirectory.description: The directory a Caddy edge loads delivered certificates from: one plain absolute path.

CaddyRequestedHost.description: An upstream that names the host each request names, with an optional fixed port (the captured group).

GitHubDeliveryProduction.description: What a github.delivery record says of production once every extension's latest admission runs there. Until then it says what stands between.
enum: Every extension's latest admission, confirmed on GitHub

GitHubDeliverySpec.description: A github.delivery declaration. The defaults are the declaration a sweep reports and HQ adopts.

repository.description: owner/name of the repository whose composition workflow deploys HQ.

GitHubProfilePlan.description: Whose public GitHub profile the controller reads, and whether to read now. The accounts are the ones a person's sign-in names. The profile keeps a slower clock than the sweep, which HQ holds: due says the reading is old enough or somebody asked.

GitHubProfileBounds.description: The bounds of a github.profile record, stated here for both sides. GitHub allows an address 60 anonymous calls an hour, and one account costs the profile, the stars and the picture, then a release call and an advisory call for each watched repository: 3 + 2 x watched.maxItems.

watched.description: The newest starred repositories, each with its latest release and published advisories.

avatar.description: The picture as a data: URI, so a page loads no image from another host.

HostUnitRecord.description: One systemd unit on the controller's machine, as `systemctl show` states it: the host.unit reading's record. The launcher asks systemd for exactly these properties of the units the repository ships, and the controller reports no other. Each string is a unit name, one of systemd's state words or an instant in UTC; none is a path, a command line or an environment.

load.description: LoadState: loaded, or why systemd holds no configuration for it (not-found, masked, error, bad-setting).

file_state.description: UnitFileState: whether the unit file is enabled, static or disabled. Absent for a unit with no file.

active.description: ActiveState: active, inactive, activating, deactivating, failed and the like.

sub.description: SubState: the unit type's own word for the same state, such as waiting or elapsed for a timer.

result.description: Result: success, or why the last run failed (exit-code, signal, timeout and the like).

main_code.description: ExecMainCode: how the main process of the last run ended, as the kernel's code (1 exited, 2 killed, 3 dumped).

main_status.description: ExecMainStatus: the exit status or signal number of the main process of the last run.

started_at.description: InactiveExitTimestamp: when the last start began, on this boot.

ended_at.description: InactiveEnterTimestamp: when the unit last became inactive or failed, on this boot.

condition.description: ConditionResult: yes or no, whether the unit's conditions held when last checked. A start whose conditions do not hold is skipped without failing.

condition_at.description: ConditionTimestamp: when the conditions were last checked.

last_trigger_at.description: LastTriggerUSec: when a timer last started its unit.

next_elapse_at.description: NextElapseUSecRealtime: when a timer with a calendar schedule next elapses.

activates.description: Unit: the unit a timer or path starts.

ConnectionProvider.description: A connection provider HQ's registry declares: what a credential is for. Django's contract test holds this to the admitted connections.

ReadingPartName.description: A part a reading is read in, as HQ's registry declares them; empty for the whole reading. HQ stores a refusal only for a part the kind declares, and Django's contract test holds this to the declared parts.

TLSCertificateName.description: A certbot lineage name: it becomes --cert-name and a directory under live/. HQ's tls.certificate declaration validates with it and the controller checks it again where it reaches certbot's argv and a path.

TLSCertificateDomain.description: A domain certbot is asked for: DNS labels, optionally under one wildcard. The controller checks it where it reaches certbot's argv.

CloudflareCAAValue.description: A CAA record's content as flags, tag and quoted value (the three groups). HQ validates a declared CAA record with it and both sides take the content apart with it.

ConditionType.description: What a condition says of a resource: it is as declared, it differs from the declaration, or it needs attention.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem: why HQ refused or failed a bridge call.

BridgeBody.description: One bridge message as sent: maxLength is the most bytes either side accepts as a request or an answer.

LeaseSeconds.description: How long a claimed operation is leased, in seconds. The controller sends the default; HQ applies it when none is sent.

JobOutcome.description: How one piece of scheduled work ended. Running means a job of this kind was already live.

JobState.description: How a job stands when HQ answers for it.
